47:    "prepare": "pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run generate:map-glyphs && pnpm run generate:material-symbol-names && pnpm run version:stamp",
===
    "prepare": "pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run generate:map-glyphs && pnpm run generate:material-symbol-names && pnpm run version:stamp",
    "release": "pnpm nx release",
    "start": "pnpm nx serve app",
    "start:android": "pnpm nx run app:build:android && nx run app:sync:android && nx run app:run:android",
    "start:api-prod-proxy": "pnpm nx serve app --configuration=with-proxy --no-hmr",
    "start-boards:api-prod-proxy": "nx serve urboards --configuration=with-proxy",
    "start:api-prod-proxy:external": "pnpm nx serve app --configuration=with-proxy --host 0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts all",
    "start-boards": "pnpm nx serve urboards",
    "start:ios": "pnpm nx run app:build:ios && nx run app:sync:ios && nx run app:run:ios",
    "sync:android": "pnpm nx build app --prod --skip-nx-cache && ionic capacitor sync android --no-build",
    "sync:android:local": "pnpm nx build app --configuration=local-android --skip-nx-cache && cross-env URBO_ANDROID_SCHEME=http ionic capacitor sync android --no-build",
    "sync:ios": "pnpm nx build app --prod && ionic capacitor sync ios --no-build",
    "sync:packages": "node ../scripts/sync-packages.js",
    "test": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx run-many -t test",
    "test:adapter": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test adapter",
    "test:app": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test app",
    "test:core": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test core",
    "test:feature-app-feedback": "pnpm run typecheck-tests &&  nx test feature-app-feedback",
    "test:feature-citizen-participation": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test feature-citizen-participation",
    "test:feature-events": "pnpm run typecheck-tests && nx test feature-events",

observation.command: cd /workspace/app; grep -n "\"prepare\"\|\"postinstall\"\|\"preinstall\"" package.json; echo ===; sed -n '/"prepare"/,/}/p' package.json | head -20
